Ritika Chauhan
Senior Business Development Manager | Gurugram, Haryana
ritika.chauhan750@example.com | +91 9873748085

Experienced B2B sales leader with a proven track record of driving revenue growth across retail and enterprise segments. Strong background in pipeline development, CRM-driven account management, and implementing Salesforce processes to scale sales operations. Known for building cross-functional relationships and delivering consistent quota overachievement.

Experience

Nykaa — Jan 2026 - Present
Senior Business Development Manager (Hybrid)
- Built and qualified a B2B pipeline worth INR 45M within first six months by leveraging Lead Generation campaigns and targeted outreach, converting 12 enterprise partners into active sellers; used Salesforce to track deal stages and forecast monthly revenue.
- Designed CRM workflows and automated follow-ups, reducing average sales cycle from 90 to 58 days and increasing lead-to-opportunity conversion by 28%.
- Led strategic negotiations with top 20 regional retailers, closing partnerships that contributed 18% of new category revenue in Q2; reported progress via Salesforce dashboards to cross-functional stakeholders.

Infosys — Jan 2019 - Dec 2025
Account Executive (Onsite)
- Managed a portfolio of enterprise accounts generating annual contract value of INR 120M; drove renewal and upsell activity through CRM-based account plans and quarterly business reviews.
- Implemented lead scoring and segmentation in CRM, improving qualified lead velocity by 32% and shortening time-to-pipeline by 22%.
- Collaborated with proposals and delivery teams to convert 9 major RFPs, achieving a win rate improvement from 24% to 41% over two years and maintaining sales forecast accuracy using Salesforce.

Bluefin Logistics — Apr 2013 - Dec 2018
Sales Manager (Field)
- Grew regional B2B client base by 65% over three years through proactive Lead Generation, cold outreach, and relationship management; secured multi-year logistics contracts totaling INR 80M.
- Standardized CRM usage across the sales team and introduced Salesforce reporting templates, improving visibility into deal stages and reducing administration time by 35%.
- Trained and mentored a team of six sales executives on enterprise sales processes and CRM best practices, increasing team quota attainment from 72% to 95%.

PhonePe — Mar 2012 - Mar 2013
Account Executive (Field)
- Launched channel partnerships and merchant acquisition initiatives that onboarded 1,200+ small and medium merchants in target districts within nine months using focused Lead Generation strategies.
- Managed end-to-end sales cycle for B2B merchants, maintained CRM records for prospecting and follow-up, and used Salesforce to reconcile onboarding status and performance metrics.
- Ran pilot programs with select merchants to optimize acceptance workflows, resulting in a 14% uplift in transaction volumes for participating partners.

Projects
- Sales Automation Implementation: Led a cross-functional project to deploy Salesforce automation for lead routing and opportunity scoring at Nykaa, cutting manual handoffs by 50% and improving rep productivity.
- CRM Clean-up & Migration: At Bluefin Logistics, spearheaded a CRM data hygiene initiative and migration to standardized Salesforce objects, resulting in a 40% reduction in duplicate records and more reliable reporting.

Skills
Business: B2B Sales, Lead Generation, CRM, Salesforce
Tools & DevOps: Git, Jira, Linux

Education
B.Tech, Electronics, NIT Trichy
